class MacosBatteryExporter < Formula
  desc "Prometheus exporter for battery metrics"
  homepage "https://github.com/jimeh/macos-battery-exporter"
  url "https://github.com/jimeh/macos-battery-exporter/archive/refs/tags/v0.0.7.tar.gz"
  sha256 "bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb"
  license "MIT"

  depends_on :macos
  depends_on "go" => :build

  def install
    system "go", "build", *std_go_args
  end
end
